newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow $64 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade slow $64 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said.

Limited test slaughter steers and heifers mostly steady. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 4,200 slaughter steers and 100 heifers; 125,400 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,000 formulated and 1,500 previously contract cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.50-64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Confirmed - 4,300 Week Ago - 1,600 Week Ago - None
Wk to Date - 125,400 Week Ago - 26,700 Week Ago - 40,400
